title: Soara and the House of Monsters TV Anime Announced for 2027, First Trailer and Main Cast Revealed
content: Hidenori Yamaji’s fantasy manga Soara and the House of Monsters is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for 2027. The announcement was made with an ultra teaser visual, the first teaser trailer, and the reveal of the anime’s main cast and staff.
author: Anime Corner

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 1 Begins Streaming Worldwide on Netflix
content: Netflix has added That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (TenSura) Season 1 to its global catalog, making the first season of Rimuru Tempest’s isekai adventure available to subscribers worldwide. The announcement was made through the platform’s official social media channels on June 30.

title: 4 Years Later, Acclaimed Historical Shonen Jump Series Finally Confirms an Anime
content: Weekly Shonen Jump ‘s gag humor manga, Super Psychic Policeman Chojo , by Shun Numa, was axed in June last year, leading to a rushed ending. The manga debuted in February 2024 and reached its conclusion in Chapter 64.

title: Attack on Titan’s Original Studio Confirms Brand New Anime For 2027
content: Based on the acclaimed manga by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity ever since its debut in 2013. The series was initially adapted by WIT Studio and released the first three seasons of the anime.

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Shojo of the Year Confirms Finale Without a Season 2
